title: Everyday Phrases — Giving Compliments
scene_zh: 真誠讚美 · 情境對話
title_quote: Good morning! Your garden looks amazing.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💛 實用真誠讚美必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Giving Compliments
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用真誠讚美情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從清晨誇鄰居的花園、稱讚新外套與笑容，到辦公室肯定同事的漂亮簡報、互相打氣，再到朋友廚房裡誇手藝、討教配方，最後夜晚家人互道「你今天做得真好」與溫柔晚安，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多社交場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Giving Compliments phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), following one warm day: praising a neighbor's garden, new coat and smile in the morning; celebrating a coworker's clear presentation and cheering each other on; complimenting a friend's cooking and asking for the recipe; and at night, family members affirming each other and drifting off with gentle goodnight words. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning! Your garden looks amazing.
dialogue.zh: 早安！你的花園看起來太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks! I water it every dawn.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！我每天清晨都會澆水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These red roses are so beautiful.
dialogue.zh: 這些紅玫瑰真是太美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I grew them from tiny seeds.
dialogue.zh: 它們是我從小種子一手帶大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A green thumb runs in your family.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡrin θʌm rʌnz ɪn jʊr ˈfæməli./
dialogue.zh: 這手園藝天分，一看就是家傳的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Haha, my mother taught me well.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，是我母親教得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you keep it so tidy?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju kip ɪt soʊ ˈtaɪdi./
dialogue.zh: 你是怎麼把花園弄得這麼整齊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I trim the hedges every week.
dialogue.zh: 我每週都會修剪灌木叢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The whole street loves your flowers.
dialogue.zh: 整條街的人都喜歡你的花。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now you're making me blush.
dialogue.zh: 你這麼一說，我臉都紅了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I always stop to smell them.
dialogue.zh: 我路過總會停下來聞花香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They smell better up close.
dialogue.zh: 湊近了聞，香氣還更濃呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your new coat looks great on you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr nu koʊt lʊks ɡreɪt ɑn ju./
dialogue.zh: 這件新外套穿在你身上真好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh! I just bought it last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ! aɪ dʒʌst bɔt ɪt læst wik./
dialogue.zh: 噢！我上週才剛買的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blue really suits your skin.
dialogue.zh: 這個藍色很襯你的膚色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue is my favorite color too.
dialogue.zh: 藍色剛好也是我最愛的顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you get this warm coat?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ju ɡɛt ðɪs wɔrm koʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 這件暖和的外套在哪買的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the small shop near the park.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ðə smɔl ʃɑp nɪr ðə pɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 就在公園旁邊那家小店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the coat very expensive?
dialogue.zh: 那件外套很貴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it was half price!
dialogue.zh: 不，剛好是半價！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll try that shop myself soon.
dialogue.zh: 我改天一定自己去那家店看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go this weekend? I'll join you.
dialogue.zh: 這週末去嗎？我跟你一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your scarf matches the coat perfectly.
dialogue.zh: 你的圍巾和外套搭得恰到好處。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My sister picked it out for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsɪstər pɪkt ɪt aʊt fər mi./
dialogue.zh: 那是姊姊幫我挑選的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you plan these flower beds alone?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju plæn ðiːz ˈflaʊər bɛdz əˈloʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 這些花圃都是你自己規劃的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, my dog helped too.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，我的狗也算幫忙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that a tomato plant over there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ə təˈmeɪo plænt ˈoʊvər ðɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 那邊那株是番茄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is! Fresh salad soon.
dialogue.zh: 是呀！很快就能吃上新鮮沙拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This garden must make you proud.
dialogue.zh: 這座花園，一定讓你滿心驕傲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's my happy place, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，這裡是我的快樂小天地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The best time to garden is dawn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛst taɪm tə ˈɡɑrdən ɪz dɔn./
dialogue.zh: 整理花園最好的時間，就是天剛亮的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why I love sunrise.
dialogue.zh: 所以我才這麼喜歡日出時分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you listen to music while gardening?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju ˈlɪsən tə ˈmjuzɪk waɪl ˈɡɑrdənɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 你整理花園時會聽音樂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, soft jazz keeps me company.
dialogue.zh: 會呀，輕爵士一路陪著我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Enter the flower contest this year.
dialogue.zh: 今年就去報名花卉比賽吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, I'm not that good yet.
dialogue.zh: 噢，我還沒那麼厲害啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd vote for your garden any day.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd voʊt fər jʊr ˈɡɑrdən ˈɛni deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 不管什麼時候我都投你的花園。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You always say the kindest things.
dialogue.zh: 你總說最讓人溫暖的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your smile really brightens my day.
dialogue.zh: 你的笑容真的讓我一整天都明亮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your kindness brightens mine.
dialogue.zh: 而你的善意也照亮了我的一天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you garden before breakfast daily?
dialogue.zh: 你天天早餐前都來澆花嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost always. It wakes me up.
dialogue.zh: 幾乎天天。它讓我徹底清醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The birds seem to love your yard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɜ bɜrdz sim tə lʌv jʊr jɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 小鳥們好像特別喜歡你的院子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I put out seeds for them.
dialogue.zh: 我特地為牠們撒了飼料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That little bench by the gate is sweet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈlɪtəl bɛntʃ baɪ ðə ɡeɪt ɪz swit./
dialogue.zh: 門口那張小長椅真可愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My husband built it years ago.
dialogue.zh: 是我先生好幾年前親手做的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He made it with real care.
dialogue.zh: 看得出他做得非常用心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He still trims the lawn for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi stɪl trɪmz ðə lɔn fər mi./
dialogue.zh: 到現在他還常幫我修剪草坪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any plant thrives under your care.
dialogue.zh: 花草到了你手上，個個長得旺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you! Plants never judge anyone.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！植物從不會評判誰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I snap these roses to keep?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ snæp ðiːz ˈroʊzɪz tə kip?/
dialogue.zh: 我能拍張這些玫瑰留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! Pick your favorite one.
dialogue.zh: 當然可以！挑你最喜歡的那朵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sister truly loves flowers.
dialogue.zh: 我姊姊真的很愛花。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then bring her by next Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 那下週天帶她來逛逛吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We could swap some gardening tips.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以交流幾種養花心得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd love that. Bring coffee?
dialogue.zh: 太好啦。帶杯咖啡來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The best seat in town is by your fence.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛst sit ɪn taʊn ɪz baɪ jʊr fɛns./
dialogue.zh: 全鎮最好的座位，就在你家籬笆邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flattery! Want a rose to go?
dialogue.zh: 你真會說話！帶朵玫瑰上路嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A rose? How thoughtful of you!
dialogue.zh: 一朵玫瑰？你也太貼心了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the least I can do.
dialogue.zh: 這只是我的一點小心意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your flowers make spring last longer.
dialogue.zh: 你的花讓春天變得更漫長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your compliments make my morning.
dialogue.zh: 你的讚美讓這個早晨更美好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I admire how patient you are.
dialogue.zh: 我很佩服你這份耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seeds teach patience, for sure.
dialogue.zh: 種子最教人耐心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that lavender by your front door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ˈlævəndər baɪ jʊr frʌnt dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 你大門邊種的是薰衣草嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it calms me in the evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt kɑmz mi ɪn ði ˈivnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 是啊，傍晚聞著特別讓人心靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your whole house feels welcoming.
dialogue.zh: 你家整棟房子都讓人覺得親切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means a lot, coming from you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ə lɑt, ˈkʌmɪŋ frʌm ju./
dialogue.zh: 從你口中聽到，意義格外重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You grow the tallest sunflowers here.
dialogue.zh: 這一帶就屬你的向日葵最高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The kids stand under them and laugh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɪdz stænd ˈʌndər ðɛm ənd læf./
dialogue.zh: 孩子們常站在花下哈哈大笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A gardening class needs a teacher.
dialogue.zh: 園藝班正缺一位好老師呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe someday, with free seedlings.
dialogue.zh: 也許哪天吧，還送小苗那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd sign up for that class.
dialogue.zh: 那我一定第一個報名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First lesson: enjoy the slow parts.
dialogue.zh: 第一課：學會慢慢欣賞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who arranged these pots so carefully?
dialogue.zh: 這些花盆是誰擺的，這樣講究？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The corner one was my daughter's idea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔrnər wʌn wʌz maɪ ˈdɔtɚz aɪˈdiə./
dialogue.zh: 角落那個是女兒出的主意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She has your good eye, then.
dialogue.zh: 那她遺傳了你的好眼光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids notice everything, don't they?
dialogue.zh: 小孩什麼都看在眼裡，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even in rain, this garden shines.
dialogue.zh: 就算下雨，這花園一樣在發亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rain washes the leaves so clean.
dialogue.zh: 雨水把葉子沖得特別乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your flowers go to every doorstep.
dialogue.zh: 你的花總送到家家戶戶的門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beauty grows when it's given away.
dialogue.zh: 美分享出去，反而長得更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a lovely start to the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ə ˈlʌvli stɑrt tə ðə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 多美好的開頭啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same chat tomorrow, if you like.
dialogue.zh: 喜歡的話，明天同一時間再聊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll wave at you from my door.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl weɪv æt ju frʌm maɪ dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我會在家門口跟你揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll save a bloom for you.
dialogue.zh: 我會幫你留一朵盛開的花。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My whole morning feels brighter now.
dialogue.zh: 你讓我整個上午都亮了起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, your compliment made mine.
dialogue.zh: 你的讚美也讓我心情大好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have a wonderful day, neighbor.
dialogue.zh: 祝你今天過得精彩，鄰居。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too! Enjoy your walk.
dialogue.zh: 你也是！好好享受散步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, I'm not done admiring.
dialogue.zh: 等一下，我還沒看夠呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time. The roses stay.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢看，玫瑰花又不會跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It smells like summer out here.
dialogue.zh: 站在這裡聞起來像夏天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the jasmine climbing the wall.
dialogue.zh: 是牆上那股攀爬的茉莉香。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you decide about the contest, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju dɪˈsaɪd əˈbaʊt ðə ˈkɑnˌtɛst, ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那個花卉比賽，你想好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I did! I'm entering with my roses.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd! aɪm ˈɛntərɪŋ wɪð maɪ ˈroʊzɪz./
dialogue.zh: 報名啦！我要帶我的玫瑰去參賽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I mean every word I said.
dialogue.zh: 我說的每個字都是真心話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I believe you. The flowers heard it too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliv ju. ðə ˈflaʊərz hɜrd ɪt tu./
dialogue.zh: 我信。連花都聽見你的好話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your compliments are works of art.
dialogue.zh: 你的讚美簡直是藝術品。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours planted the seeds, though.
dialogue.zh: 可是種子是你先播下的呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your presentation today was fantastic.
dialogue.zh: 你今天的簡報實在太精彩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really? I doubted myself all morning.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我整個上午都在懷疑自己。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The numbers were easy to follow.
dialogue.zh: 那些數據看起來特別好懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I sorted them by month first.
dialogue.zh: 我先把它們按月份整理過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your charts spoke for themselves.
dialogue.zh: 你的圖表一目了然。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I redrew those bars three times.
dialogue.zh: 那幾張長條圖我重畫了三遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How gently you explained the hard parts!
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈdʒɛntli ju ɪkˈsplænd ðə hɑrd pɑrts!/
dialogue.zh: 那些最難的部分，你講得多溫柔啊！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I imagined talking to my aunt.
dialogue.zh: 其實我假裝是在跟阿姨說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you rehearse at home?
dialogue.zh: 你在家裡排練過了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice last night, actually.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，昨晚練了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your voice stayed calm and steady.
dialogue.zh: 你的聲音一路都很平穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inside, my heart was racing!
dialogue.zh: 其實我心跳快得像跑步！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Were you nervous up there?
dialogue.zh: 你站在台上緊張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very! My hands shook a little.
dialogue.zh: 很緊張！手都有點發抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nobody could tell. Great job.
dialogue.zh: 完全看不出來。做得漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means a lot to me.
dialogue.zh: 你這句話對我意義重大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looked pure ease up there.
dialogue.zh: 你在台上看起來輕鬆極了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It took weeks of small efforts.
dialogue.zh: 其實是好幾週的小努力堆出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The manager nodded the whole time.
dialogue.zh: 經理全程都在點頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I noticed! It helped a lot.
dialogue.zh: 我有看到！那給了我好多勇氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her feedback was really positive.
dialogue.zh: 她的回饋非常正面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She even asked for my template.
dialogue.zh: 她甚至跟我要了簡報模板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A new hire looked inspired.
dialogue.zh: 新來的同事看起來備受鼓舞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope so. I felt small once.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp soʊ. aɪ fɛlt smɔl wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 但願吧。我當年也覺得自己很小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who helped you, back in your first week?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu hɛlpt ju, bæk ɪn jʊr fɜrst wik?/
dialogue.zh: 你第一週的時候，是誰幫了你？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did, actually. Don't you remember?
dialogue.zh: 其實就是你呀。你還記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you walk me through slide four?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju wɔk mi θru slaɪd fɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 能帶我過一遍第四頁嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, after our coffee break?
dialogue.zh: 好啊，咖啡休息之後行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for offering to teach me.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你主動願意教我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You shared your notes with me.
dialogue.zh: 你也把筆記分享給過我呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We two work brilliantly together.
dialogue.zh: 我們倆搭檔工作真有默契。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The best kind, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，是最好的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your summary was short and sharp.
dialogue.zh: 你的總結乾脆又俐落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Short is my favorite length.
dialogue.zh: 短，是我最喜歡的長度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every question got a good answer.
dialogue.zh: 每一個問題你都答得恰當。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two were lucky guesses, quietly.
dialogue.zh: 悄悄說，有兩個是我蒙對的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky guesses sounded professional.
dialogue.zh: 蒙的聽起來也很專業。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please don't tell anyone!
dialogue.zh: 拜託別跟任何人說！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, your honesty is refreshing.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，這份坦白反倒讓人喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I had a patient practice partner.
dialogue.zh: 誰叫我有一位耐煩的練習夥伴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only asked questions at dinner.
dialogue.zh: 晚餐時我不過是提問罷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was exactly the practice.
dialogue.zh: 那可正是最管用的練習。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you build this deck alone?
dialogue.zh: 這份簡報是你一個人做的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly, with Ben's spreadsheet help.
dialogue.zh: 大部分是，還有班幫忙做表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben's data was spot on.
dialogue.zh: 本的資料精準得沒話說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your design sense saved it.
dialogue.zh: 而你的設計感救活了整份報告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every color here was well chosen.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的每個顏色都挑得準。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I copied your slides from March.
dialogue.zh: 我是跟你三月的簡報學的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm glad they came in handy.
dialogue.zh: 高興它們派上了用場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it's your turn to be praised.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪts jʊr tɜrn tə bi prɛzd./
dialogue.zh: 現在換成你被誇啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's celebrate with lunch today.
dialogue.zh: 今天午餐來慶祝一下吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The noodle place on Fifth?
dialogue.zh: 是五街那家麵店嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My treat. You earned it.
dialogue.zh: 我請客，你當之無愧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I'll order the big bowl.
dialogue.zh: 那我就要點大碗的囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How smoothly you handled that glitch!
dialogue.zh: 那個小故障，被你處理得多順呀！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My heart skipped, but it worked.
dialogue.zh: 我嚇得心跳漏一拍，但撐過來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Switching screens looked planned.
dialogue.zh: 換畫面看起來像預留的安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was pure panic, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，當下純粹是慌張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those public talks suit you more now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoz ˈpʌblɪk tɔks sut ju mɔr naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 如今的公開演講，你越講越自在了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Public talks still scare me a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʌblɪk tɔks stɪl skɛr mi ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不過上台還是會怕一點啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Talking scared is real courage.
dialogue.zh: 害怕還肯開口，才是真勇氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save that line for my next deck.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ðæt laɪn fər maɪ nɛkst dɛk./
dialogue.zh: 這一句我要留進下次簡報。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The office has a quiet hero.
dialogue.zh: 咱們辦公室藏著一位低調英雄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hero who takes coffee breaks.
dialogue.zh: 是需要喝個咖啡緩一緩的英雄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your title slide looked striking.
dialogue.zh: 你的封面頁好亮眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That font was one night of study.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt fɑnt wʌz wʌn naɪt əv ˈstʌdi./
dialogue.zh: 那個字型是我熬夜研究來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One night? You have real talent.
dialogue.zh: 一個晚上？你很有天分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: YouTube taught me everything there.
dialogue.zh: 那上面全是我自學的網課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You'll present the quarterly report next.
dialogue.zh: 下季度的報告輪到你主講了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope I do half as well.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp aɪ du hæf æz wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 但願我能有你一半好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better than that, for sure.
dialogue.zh: 你一定會更好，這我敢說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your belief helps more than you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr bɪˈlif hɛlps mɔr ðæn ju noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 你不知道，你的相信幫了我多大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I believe it because I watched you.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliv ɪt bɪˈkɔz aɪ wɑtʃt ju./
dialogue.zh: 我信，因為我看著你一路練成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watching is a kind of helping.
dialogue.zh: 願意注視，本身就是一種幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep your slide file?
dialogue.zh: 我可以存一份你的簡報檔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course — it's yours now.
dialogue.zh: 當然——它現在是你的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I change the graph colors?
dialogue.zh: 我該換掉報表的顏色嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the blues; everyone loved them.
dialogue.zh: 留下藍色吧，大家都喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone means the whole room.
dialogue.zh: 我說的大家，是滿屋子的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the whole room has excellent taste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə hoʊl rum hæz ˈɛksələnt teɪst./
dialogue.zh: 那這一整屋人的品味，可真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You even finished early. Real skill.
dialogue.zh: 你還提前講完，真有本事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I skipped the water joke.
dialogue.zh: 我把那個水的笑話省掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The water story was funny, though.
dialogue.zh: 那個笑話其實挺好笑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time, budget extra minutes.
dialogue.zh: 下次我多留幾分鐘講它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stories come easy from you.
dialogue.zh: 故事從你嘴裡輕輕就流出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Numbers are my storylines now.
dialogue.zh: 如今數字就是我的劇情線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The client asked for your name.
dialogue.zh: 客戶特別問了你的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No kidding? That's amazing news.
dialogue.zh: 不是吧？這消息太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No kidding. She wrote it down.
dialogue.zh: 沒開玩笑，她還記下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I must stay this sharp.
dialogue.zh: 那我更得保持這份敏銳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You'll stay sharp, I'm sure.
dialogue.zh: 你一定會一直這麼敏銳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for cheering me on.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你一路替我加油。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It helps to have supportive people.
dialogue.zh: 身邊有支持你的人真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this whole office, right?
dialogue.zh: 就像整個辦公室，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This place really feels like a team.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs pleɪs ˈrɪli filz laɪk ə tim./
dialogue.zh: 這裡真的很有團隊的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Because you greet everyone warmly.
dialogue.zh: 因為你總跟每個人溫暖地問好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's call it a win today.
dialogue.zh: 今天就把它當成一場勝利。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A shared win. See you tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 共同的勝利。明天見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your slides set a new standard.
dialogue.zh: 你這套簡報立下了新標準。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our standard, you mean.
dialogue.zh: 你說過，那是我們的水準。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This soup tastes incredible.
dialogue.zh: 這湯的味道太驚人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're being generous.
dialogue.zh: 你是客氣啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you make the broth from scratch?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju meɪk ðə brɔθ frʌm skrætʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 湯底是你從頭熬的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It took just two hours.
dialogue.zh: 只熬了兩個小時而已。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hours? That's real talent.
dialogue.zh: 兩小時？那是真功夫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mostly patience, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，大多是耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's your secret with the garlic?
dialogue.zh: 你放蒜頭有什麼祕訣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add it last, always.
dialogue.zh: 永遠最後才下鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I never think of timing like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈnɛvər θɪŋk əv ˈtaɪmɪŋ laɪk ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 我從沒想過放料的時機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Timing is half the recipe.
dialogue.zh: 時機就佔了配方的一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I try making it someday?
dialogue.zh: 改天我能試著做一次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll stand beside you teaching.
dialogue.zh: 我站在你旁邊教你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Teaching? You're the best student.
dialogue.zh: 教我？你才是最會學的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've burned just two pans.
dialogue.zh: 我也只燒壞過兩個鍋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everyone starts by burning something.
dialogue.zh: 誰不是從燒壞東西開始的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That really helps my nerves.
dialogue.zh: 這樣說我的膽子壯多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you learn this from your mother?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju lɜrn ðɪs frʌm jʊr ˈmʌðər?/
dialogue.zh: 這手藝是跟你母親學的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From my grandmother's kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 是從我外婆的廚房學的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her recipes must be precious.
dialogue.zh: 她的食譜一定很珍貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They live only in my memory.
dialogue.zh: 它們只存在我的記憶裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No written cards at all?
dialogue.zh: 竟一張都沒寫下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not one. Taste, then adjust.
dialogue.zh: 一張也沒有。先嚐，再調。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's harder than any cookbook.
dialogue.zh: 這比照譜煮難多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cookbooks don't sniff the pot.
dialogue.zh: 可食譜不會幫你聞鍋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you make this bread too?
dialogue.zh: 這麵包也是你烤的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two loaves this morning.
dialogue.zh: 今天早上烤了兩條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It rose perfectly, like clouds.
dialogue.zh: 它發得蓬軟得像雲朵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The oven did most of that.
dialogue.zh: 大部分功勞要給烤箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The crust looks golden and crisp.
dialogue.zh: 外皮金黃又酥脆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Butter, time, a little faith.
dialogue.zh: 奶油、時間，加一點信心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plated just like a real café.
dialogue.zh: 這擺盤，活像一家正經咖啡廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My café has one crooked shelf.
dialogue.zh: 我那小館只有一個歪架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even that shelf has real character.
dialogue.zh: 連那架子都自有風采。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You flatter a messy kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 你是在誇我這亂廚房吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What herb is this green sprinkle?
dialogue.zh: 撒的這綠色香草是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Parsley from the window box.
dialogue.zh: 窗台花盆裡摘的歐芹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This window box grows anything at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈwɪndoʊ bɑks ɡroʊz ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ət ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 你窗台那箱土，什麼都長得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything but my patience.
dialogue.zh: 除了我的耐心以外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rice is light and fluffy.
dialogue.zh: 米飯輕盈又鬆軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I rinsed it twice, quietly proud.
dialogue.zh: 我淘了兩遍，暗自得意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open a little place some day!
dialogue.zh: 哪天真該開一間小店鋪！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd never share my mornings.
dialogue.zh: 我可捨不得分享我的清晨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair point. I'm glad we're friends.
dialogue.zh: 說得是。很高興我們是朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same table, different appetites.
dialogue.zh: 同一張桌，不同的食量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My appetite is the bigger one.
dialogue.zh: 我的食量當然是比較大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take the last dumpling.
dialogue.zh: 那最後一顆餃子給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The last dumpling? For me?
dialogue.zh: 最後一顆餃子？給我的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A guest should eat like family.
dialogue.zh: 客人就該像家人那樣吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's the warmest offer today.
dialogue.zh: 這是今天最暖的一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's only a dumpling, really.
dialogue.zh: 不就一顆餃子嘛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring dessert next time?
dialogue.zh: 下次我帶甜點來好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you make it badly.
dialogue.zh: 除非你把它做難吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Badly? I'll practice all week.
dialogue.zh: 難吃？那我先練習一週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even your practice will taste good.
dialogue.zh: 連你練習做的都會好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have the dessert recipe?
dialogue.zh: 你有那道甜點的配方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine: cream, sugar, no plan.
dialogue.zh: 我的配方：鮮奶油、糖、沒計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No plan? That's brave.
dialogue.zh: 沒計畫？真大膽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Custard rewards the brave.
dialogue.zh: 卡士達布丁專獎大膽的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd trust your kitchen advice now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在完全信你的廚房建議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow: try shallots, not onions.
dialogue.zh: 明天開始用紅蔥頭，別用洋蔥。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shallots. I'll remember that.
dialogue.zh: 紅蔥頭，我記下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Repeat it while holding an onion.
dialogue.zh: 剝洋蔥時多唸幾遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Since when are you teaching me?
dialogue.zh: 你從什麼時候開始教我了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You learn like someone hungry.
dialogue.zh: 你學得像餓肚子的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's in this dipping sauce?
dialogue.zh: 這沾醬裡有什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soy, lime, one pinch of sugar.
dialogue.zh: 醬油、萊姆，一小撮糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pinch of sugar changes all?
dialogue.zh: 一撮糖就能改變全部？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It wakes up every other flavor.
dialogue.zh: 它把其他風味全叫醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does all this coffee come from?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ɔl ðɪs ˈkɔfi kʌm frʌm?/
dialogue.zh: 你哪來這麼多咖啡呀？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You kept the conversation warm.
dialogue.zh: 你也讓話題一直保溫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That kneading shows a baker's hands.
dialogue.zh: 這揉麵的手法，一看就是麵包師傅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bread forgives a gentle touch.
dialogue.zh: 麵包原諒溫柔的觸碰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you make that jam yourself?
dialogue.zh: 那罐果醬是你自己熬的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, from our balcony berries.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，用陽台種的果子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These berries grew on a balcony?
dialogue.zh: 這些果子長在陽台上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One pot, big dreams, care.
dialogue.zh: 一盆土、大夢想，加用心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your home is a good kitchen school.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr hoʊm ɪz ə ɡʊd ˈkɪtʃən skul./
dialogue.zh: 你家是一所很好的廚房學校。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're a quick and eager student.
dialogue.zh: 你是又快又專心的學生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beginners never feel lost around you.
dialogue.zh: 新手在你身邊，從不覺得無助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone cooks badly on day one.
dialogue.zh: 誰第一天煮都難吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Even my eggs improved today.
dialogue.zh: 今天連我的蛋都進步了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Momentum is delicious.
dialogue.zh: 看見沒？進步是好吃的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What others miss, you always notice.
dialogue.zh: 別人沒看見的，你總是先看見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good cooks watch, taste, adjust.
dialogue.zh: 好廚師就是看、嚐、調。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a life lesson in a pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə laɪf ˈlɛsən ɪn ə pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 這簡直是鍋裡的人生課。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most of mine fit in a pot.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst əv maɪn fɪt ɪn ə pɑt./
dialogue.zh: 我的人生心得一鍋就裝得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The portions were perfectly generous.
dialogue.zh: 份量剛好又大方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nobody leaves my table hungry.
dialogue.zh: 沒有人會餓著離開我家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cooking with you beats restaurants.
dialogue.zh: 跟你一起煮飯勝過餐廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Restaurants never let me fail loudly.
dialogue.zh: 餐廳可不會讓我大聲失敗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then this kitchen wins tonight.
dialogue.zh: 那今晚是這廚房大勝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Home wins with one full plate.
dialogue.zh: 家，靠一桌飽足取勝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we do this every month?
dialogue.zh: 我們每月都這樣吃一次好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll pencil us in, first Friday.
dialogue.zh: 我幫我們排進每月第一個星期五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my dish fails badly?
dialogue.zh: 要是那道菜煮砸了呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We order pizza and laugh.
dialogue.zh: 那我們叫披薩，邊吃邊笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Failure tastes better with company.
dialogue.zh: 失敗有人陪就不那麼難嚥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's tonight's lesson, well learned.
dialogue.zh: 這功課今晚學得最牢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight was wonderful. Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 今晚太美好了，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come hungry that first Friday. Deal?
dialogue.zh: 那第一個星期五，空著肚子來。說定？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dinner's over, and today went well.
dialogue.zh: 晚飯收了，今天過得不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How did you know I was tired?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ dɪd ju noʊ aɪ wʌz ˈtaɪərd?/
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼知道我累了一天？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That smile at dinner never faded.
dialogue.zh: 晚飯時你那笑容就沒有淡過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That smile was mostly for you.
dialogue.zh: 那個笑容主要是給你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kids loved your bedtime stories.
dialogue.zh: 孩子們超愛你講的睡前故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Their imaginations did the work.
dialogue.zh: 是他們的想像力在幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listening well is one of your gifts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsənɪŋ wɛl ɪz wʌn əv jʊr ɡɪfts./
dialogue.zh: 會聽人說話，是你的一件天分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did the same for me.
dialogue.zh: 今天你也是一樣在聽我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I only asked one question.
dialogue.zh: 我不過是問了一句話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was the right question, though.
dialogue.zh: 可那正是該問的那句。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your tea helped me settle down.
dialogue.zh: 你泡的茶讓我的心靜下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two sugars, just how you like it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈʃʊɡərz, dʒʌst haʊ ju laɪk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 兩顆糖，剛好是你愛的味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Such a long day, and you remembered.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌtʃ ə lɔŋ deɪ, ænd ju rɪˈmɛmbərd./
dialogue.zh: 忙了這麼長的一天，你還記得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I keep the small kind things.
dialogue.zh: 溫柔的小事我都收著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Few would remember like you do.
dialogue.zh: 像你這樣記住小事的人，其實不多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Says the one who fixed my lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛz ði wʌn hu fɪkst maɪ læmp./
dialogue.zh: 話說那個修好我台燈的人是？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was just two loose wires.
dialogue.zh: 不過是兩條鬆掉的線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To me, it felt like magic.
dialogue.zh: 對我而言那像變魔術。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This house feels warm with you.
dialogue.zh: 有你在，這房子才覺得溫暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We share that, you and I.
dialogue.zh: 那是我們一起撐起來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm proud of how hard you try.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm praʊd əv haʊ hɑrd ju traɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我為你的努力感到驕傲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And I'm proud of your quiet days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd aɪm praʊd əv jʊr ˈkwaɪət deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 我也替你平靜的日子驕傲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet days count too?
dialogue.zh: 平靜的日子也算數嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every effort counts, loud or not.
dialogue.zh: 每一份努力都算數，不論有聲無聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More patient every day with you.
dialogue.zh: 跟你在一起，我一天比一天沉得住氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You taught me how to rest.
dialogue.zh: 而教會我休息的是你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Resting is harder than working.
dialogue.zh: 休息比做事還難。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You rested well today, though.
dialogue.zh: 但你今天休息得不錯呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do you see everything?
dialogue.zh: 你怎麼什麼都看得到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Living close makes seeing easy.
dialogue.zh: 靠得近，看事就容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We've grown a lot this year.
dialogue.zh: 這一年我們都長大了不少。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Side by side, step by step.
dialogue.zh: 肩並肩，一步一步那樣長大的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some days we both struggle.
dialogue.zh: 有些日子我們都很辛苦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some days we both shine.
dialogue.zh: 有些日子我們一起在發光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today was one of the shining ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ wʌz wʌn əv ðə ˈʃaɪnɪŋ wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 今天就是發光的那天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for saying it out loud.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你把它大聲說了出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good things need saying.
dialogue.zh: 好的事情就該說出口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some day, you'll be the one teaching.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm deɪ, jul bi ði wʌn ˈtitʃɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 說不定哪天，換你來教大家誇人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bath water was perfect.
dialogue.zh: 洗澡水溫剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I tested it twice, sleepily.
dialogue.zh: 我睡眼惺忪地試了兩遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone smells like a brushed dog.
dialogue.zh: 誰身上一股剛梳完毛的狗狗味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He looked extra soft tonight.
dialogue.zh: 他今晚的毛特別蓬軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He loves when you talk to him.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi lʌvz wɛn ju tɔk tə hɪm./
dialogue.zh: 他很愛聽你跟他說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He nods like a tiny judge.
dialogue.zh: 他點頭得像個小評審。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our plant survived your trip.
dialogue.zh: 你出遠門，花還活著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only because you watered it.
dialogue.zh: 那是因為你天天澆水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I just followed your note.
dialogue.zh: 我只是照你的便條做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Following notes is a talent.
dialogue.zh: 肯照便條做也是種天分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those little notes are the sweetest.
dialogue.zh: 你留的那些小便條，永遠最甜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One line is enough for love.
dialogue.zh: 愛只要一行就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow feels less scary already.
dialogue.zh: 明天感覺已經沒那麼可怕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We face it together, remember?
dialogue.zh: 我們一起面對，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Together is my favorite word.
dialogue.zh: 「一起」是我最喜歡的詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, especially tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，尤其在今晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This room smells like fresh cotton.
dialogue.zh: 這房間聞起來有乾淨棉布味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New sheets, since you asked.
dialogue.zh: 你一說想換，我就鋪上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I didn't even ask yet.
dialogue.zh: 我還沒開口問呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your smile asked for you.
dialogue.zh: 你的笑容已經幫你問了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your pillows fluff up like clouds.
dialogue.zh: 你拍的枕頭蓬得像雲朵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I fluffed them at seven.
dialogue.zh: 我七點就把它們拍鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven? That's early.
dialogue.zh: 七點？好早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slept poorly, so I kept my hands busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /slɛpt ˈpʊrli, soʊ aɪ kɛpt maɪ hændz ˈbɪzi./
dialogue.zh: 昨夜睡不好，就讓手忙一忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time wake me too.
dialogue.zh: 下次也把我叫起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You snore like a sleepy bear.
dialogue.zh: 你打呼像只瞌睡的熊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bear who adores you.
dialogue.zh: 那是一隻超愛你的熊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that one, exactly.
dialogue.zh: 對，就是那一隻。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you remember our first kitchen?
dialogue.zh: 還記得我們的第一間廚房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One chair, two mugs, dim light.
dialogue.zh: 一張椅、兩個馬克杯、暗暗的燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We looked so young then.
dialogue.zh: 那時的我們好年輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We look braver now instead.
dialogue.zh: 現在我們看起來更沉著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brave suits us.
dialogue.zh: 沉著很適合我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Comfort suits us even better.
dialogue.zh: 自在的感覺就更適合了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I like our quiet evenings best.
dialogue.zh: 我最喜歡我們安靜的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same here, with tea and nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm hɪr, wɪð ti ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls./
dialogue.zh: 我也是，一壺茶，別無所求。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More got done today than you admit.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɔr ɡɑt dʌn təˈdeɪ ðæn ju əˈmɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今天你做完的，比你承認的還多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You always see past my doubts.
dialogue.zh: 你總看得到我懷疑之外的努力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doubts lie. I watch actions.
dialogue.zh: 懷疑會說謊，我看行動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then tonight's action is sleep.
dialogue.zh: 那今晚的行動就是睡覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The best action all day.
dialogue.zh: 那是整天最好的行動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lights low, blanket warm. See?
dialogue.zh: 燈調暗了，被子也暖。看見沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The corners are tucked beautifully.
dialogue.zh: 被角收得真漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hospital corners, just for you.
dialogue.zh: 標準病房折角，專屬於你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I owe the night to you.
dialogue.zh: 這美好的夜晚要歸功於你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You owe me one. Collect it over breakfast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju oʊ mi wʌn. kəˈlɛkt ɪt ˈoʊvər ˈbrɛkfəst./
dialogue.zh: 那你先欠我一份，早餐時再還。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How generous of you.
dialogue.zh: 你可真大方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I learned it from you.
dialogue.zh: 這都是跟你學的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweet dreams, hard worker.
dialogue.zh: 親愛的勤勞者，好夢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweet dreams back at you.
dialogue.zh: 也把好夢原樣還給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you in the morning light.
dialogue.zh: 明天晨光裡見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It'll be brighter with you up.
dialogue.zh: 你一起床，它會更亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep now. I'm right here.
dialogue.zh: 睡吧，我就在身邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know. That's the best part.
dialogue.zh: 我知道。這才是最好的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, more small compliments.
dialogue.zh: 明天再說更多小小的讚美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight's were plenty good.
dialogue.zh: 今晚的已經多到剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rest your tired hands.
dialogue.zh: 讓你累了一天的手歇下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest your busy mind too.
dialogue.zh: 讓你忙轉的腦也歇下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep tight now, dear friend.
dialogue.zh: 快安睡吧，親愛的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night. Sleep all the way.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，一覺到天亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll meet you in our dreams tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl mit ju ɪn ˈaʊɚ drimz təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚，我們夢裡見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And dream of our little garden.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就在夢裡的小花園見。
